rules.title: Return window
rules.text: Physical items may be refunded within {{return_window_days}} days of delivery. After {{return_window_days}} days a standard refund is not available.

rules.title: Defective items
rules.text: Items that arrive defective or not as described may be refunded within {{defect_window_days}} days of delivery. After {{return_window_days}} days, a defect claim is checked by a team member before a decision is made.

rules.title: Digital goods
rules.text: Digital goods and software licenses are non-refundable once delivered, except where required by law. Such requests are reviewed by a team member.

rules.title: Final sale
rules.text: Items marked final sale cannot be refunded or returned.

rules.title: Automatic approval limit
rules.text: Refunds up to {{auto_approve_limit}} may be approved automatically. Refunds above {{auto_approve_limit}} are reviewed by a team member before they are approved.

rules.title: Already refunded
rules.text: An order that has already been refunded cannot be refunded again.

rules.title: Identity verification
rules.text: A refund can only be processed when the email on the ticket matches the email on the order. Order details are not shared with anyone else.

rules.title: Order status requests
rules.text: Customers may be told the status and tracking note of their own orders. Shipped orders show a tracking note with the expected delivery date.

rules.title: Late delivery
rules.text: If an order is more than 7 days late, the customer may request a refund under the return window rules.

rules.title: Out of scope
rules.text: Requests unrelated to refunds or order status (account changes, product advice, complaints about staff, legal threats) are outside what this service handles. They are passed to a team member.

categoryRules.reason: Digital goods are non-refundable; a human must check legal exceptions.
